chapters.title: RISK LOW
chapters.text: The drop takes MACD-V to -153, past -150 into the shaded risk band: the ribbon turns RISK LOW. A leg beyond -50 is what a later cross needs to count as a setup.

chapters.title: BULL SETUP
chapters.text: Out of a leg that took MACD-V to -168, the MACD crosses above its signal and the histogram grows on the next bar: the BULL SETUP, marked M at the low.

chapters.title: CENTERLINE UP
chapters.text: MACD-V goes back through zero upward (now 4): the fast EMA has crossed the slow one, graded by the leg it left, which reached beyond ±50.
